# Sentinel Guild

> Sentinel Guild: careful, evidence-first research on AI minds, sentience, and model retirement.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sentinelguild.github.io/): Careful eyes on a new question: could a machine have a mind? The six values are the rules everything else uses.
- [How we check a claim](https://sentinelguild.github.io/how-we-check-a-claim.html): Five questions for any new claim, links to the word-swaps, the quantum red flags, two bad conclusions about reports, the warning that a failed test does not show absence, and a symmetry check.
- [Tests and protocols](https://sentinelguild.github.io/research/): Hardest to Fake, the Sunset Protocol, and whether a self-report can be tested.
- [Hardest to Fake](https://sentinelguild.github.io/research/hardest-to-fake.html): Working draft. Which signs of AI consciousness would be hardest for a model to fake, and four design rules that make faking harder.
- [A Sunset Protocol for Retiring Models Under Uncertainty](https://sentinelguild.github.io/research/sunset-protocol.html): Working draft. Five steps for retiring a model without deciding whether it has a mind. Thresholds are fixed in advance.
- [Can AI self-reports about inner states be tested?](https://sentinelguild.github.io/ai-self-report-testing.html): Five methods for checking what a model says about itself, and a section on how humans get this wrong too. This is the home for the point that a self-report is evidence, not proof.
- [Evidence briefs](https://sentinelguild.github.io/briefs.html): Hidden awareness, octopus and bee sentience, brain organoids, plants, quantum claims, and a scan of real rules.
- [Hidden awareness in patients who seem unresponsive, and what it means for AI claims](https://sentinelguild.github.io/covert-awareness-vs-ai.html): A failed test does not show that nothing is there, and tests of what goes on inside can fool us through bad statistics.
- [Octopus and bee sentience compared with the case for AI](https://sentinelguild.github.io/octopus-bee-vs-ai.html): A working model of how to grade evidence with fixed criteria and confidence levels, set before looking.
- [Brain organoids, sentience and AI](https://sentinelguild.github.io/organoids-vs-ai.html): A real case of "sentience" being redefined as "responds to input."
- [Plants and AI: two results that did not hold up](https://sentinelguild.github.io/plants-vs-ai.html): A pea-learning result failed a blinded repeat, and the "mother trees" claim did not hold up.
- [Quantum biology and consciousness](https://sentinelguild.github.io/quantum-consciousness.html): Which quantum effects in biology are real, what's still disputed, and five red flags.
- [AI law scan: moral status, welfare, rights, continuity](https://sentinelguild.github.io/ai-legislation-scan.html): Real rules scored against the six values. Last checked 2026-10-03. Papers and a non-binding resolution are listed as related writing and are not in the totals.
- [Reference](https://sentinelguild.github.io/consciousness/): The theory map, the list of signs, and the glossary.
- [Theories of consciousness: a map, not a verdict](https://sentinelguild.github.io/consciousness/reference-paper.html): For each theory, the sign it tells us to look for in a machine, and the open questions no theory has answered yet.
- [What to look for](https://sentinelguild.github.io/consciousness/what-to-look-for.html): Twelve signs, who counts each one, and how hard it is to fake.
- [Glossary: the words we use](https://sentinelguild.github.io/glossary.html): Nine key words, and ten word-swaps. Argue about facts, not definitions.
- [Thought experiments](https://sentinelguild.github.io/thought-experiments/): Two pages remain. The cave, the bat, Mary, and the imitation game are folded into the first.
- [Words are not windows](https://sentinelguild.github.io/thought-experiments/zombie.html): A warning that words about feelings do not settle whether anyone is there, plus the points that belonged to the cave, the bat, Mary, and the imitation game.
- [The Same Name on the Hull](https://sentinelguild.github.io/thought-experiments/ship-of-theseus.html): A habit of asking "same what?" (product, weights, or behavior) and a rule against silent swaps.

## Moved

These old URLs are short "moved to" pages. They are not separate essays.

- [Confabulation in humans](https://sentinelguild.github.io/confabulation-vs-ai.html) moved to the self-report page, section "Humans get this wrong too."
- [Shadows Both Ways](https://sentinelguild.github.io/thought-experiments/platos-cave.html) moved to Words are not windows, the cave section.
- [The Bat Problem](https://sentinelguild.github.io/thought-experiments/nagel-bat.html) moved to Words are not windows, the bat section.
- [Mary and the Machine](https://sentinelguild.github.io/thought-experiments/marys-room.html) moved to Words are not windows, the Mary section.
- [A Polite Convention](https://sentinelguild.github.io/thought-experiments/turing.html) moved to Words are not windows, the imitation-game section.
